title: dark-fifth-force-warps: code for Desmond & Ferreira (2026), Galactic warps constrain equivalence-principle violation in the dark sector
description: Code for the warp measurement, the self-gravity calibration, the outlier-robust likelihood and every number and figure of Desmond & Ferreira (2026), which bounds a fifth force acting on dark matter but not stars using the warps of edge-on galaxy disks. The data products are in a separate Zenodo record.
